title: Implementation of Equivalence Partitioning and Boundary Value Analysis in Black Box Testing A Case Study on the Admin Website of PAUD KB Al Husna
authors: Adelia; Aisya; Dzaky Fachri Hadafi; Hasan Ismail Abdulmalik; Muhammad Nasir; Sofiyanti Indriasari
abstract: Applies Equivalence Partitioning and Boundary Value Analysis to the PAUD KB Al Husna admin website, focusing on functional defects, input validation, and error handling.
v1_reason: The abstract describes a black-box case study using Equivalence Partitioning and Boundary Value Analysis and discusses functional defects, validation, and error handling. It appears relevant at title/abstract screening; verify the study design and reported outcomes in full text.
v2_reason: Full-text review confirms a manual black-box case study using Equivalence Partitioning and Boundary Value Analysis. The study executed 82 scenarios and reported 27 failures (32.9%), including input-validation and security defects. This provides applied evidence for relevant test-design techniques and fault detection (IC1, IC2, IC4, IC5). Include as methodological/background evidence; it does not directly compare student worksheets on PURE.

title: PENGUJIAN SOFTWARE MENGGUNAKAN METODE BOUNDARY VALUE ANALYSIS DAN DECISION TABLE TESTING
abstract: Uses Boundary Value Analysis and Decision Table Testing to test a periodic pension-benefit claim form. Test scenarios and data are derived from business rules and form-validation rules; the study reports that the tested form still required improvements.
